name: palladium.any_animation_finished
description: Whether the animation of the current animation controller state has finished. Only works in animation controller transitions.

name: palladium.attack_body_yaw
description: The body twist in degrees during the vanilla attack swing.

name: palladium.attack_on_left_arm
description: Whether an attack swing is playing and the left arm is the main arm.

name: palladium.attack_on_right_arm
description: Whether an attack swing is playing and the right arm is the main arm.

name: palladium.attack_swing_x
description: The X rotation in degrees the attacking arm gets in the vanilla swing animation. Lets animations recreate the swing.

name: palladium.attack_swing_y
description: The Y rotation in degrees the attacking arm gets in the vanilla swing animation.

name: palladium.attack_swing_z
description: The Z rotation in degrees the attacking arm gets in the vanilla swing animation.

name: palladium.attack_time
description: Progress of the current attack swing, from 0 to 1. 0 when not attacking.

name: palladium.cape_x_rotation
description: The X rotation in degrees that the vanilla cape physics add on top of a cape bone. Subtract it in an animation to take full control of the cape.

name: palladium.flight_limb_pitch
description: The pitch the arms and legs should follow during flight, in degrees.

name: palladium.flight_limb_roll
description: The roll the arms and legs should follow during flight, in degrees.

name: palladium.flight_phase
description: The phase of the active flight type. Default flight: 0 none, 1 hovering, 2 moving, 3 propelled, 4 descending, 5 landing. Swinging: 0 none, 1 launching, 2 swinging, 3 released, 4 diving, 5 landing.

name: palladium.flight_pitch
description: The pitch of the current flight animation, in degrees. 0 when not flying.

name: palladium.flight_propulsion_scale
description: How far the propelled (fast) flight pose is blended in, from 0 to 1.

name: palladium.flight_roll
description: The roll of the current flight animation, in degrees. 0 when not flying.

name: palladium.flight_speed_forward
description: Forward speed during flight relative to the flight speed, from -1 (backwards) to 1.

name: palladium.flight_speed_sideways
description: Sideways speed during flight relative to the flight speed, from -1 to 1.

name: palladium.flight_yaw
description: The yaw of the current flight animation, in degrees. 0 when not flying.

name: palladium.flight_yaw_delta
description: How fast the flying entity is turning, smoothed. Useful to lean into curves.

name: palladium.get_animation_timer_eased
description: The eased animation timer of an ability, from 0 to 1. 0 if the ability is not found.

name: palladium.gliding_tick_count
description: Ticks spent gliding with an elytra. 0 when not gliding.

name: palladium.grapple_distance
description: The distance from the entity's shoulders to its grappling hook, in blocks. 0 without a hook.

name: palladium.grapple_pitch
description: The pitch from the entity's shoulders to its grappling hook, in degrees. Positive when the hook is above. 0 without a hook.

name: palladium.grapple_state
description: The state of the entity's active grappling hook: 0 none, 1 flying out, 2 pulling the entity towards a block, 3 reeling in a hooked entity.

name: palladium.grapple_yaw
description: The yaw from the entity's body to its grappling hook, in degrees from -180 to 180. Positive when the hook is to the right. 0 without a hook.

name: palladium.head_x_rotation
description: The head pitch in degrees. Negative when looking up.

name: palladium.head_y_rotation
description: The head yaw relative to the body, in degrees from -180 to 180. Unlike query.head_y_rotation this is 0 when the player looks straight ahead, which is what a head bone in an animation needs.

name: palladium.horizontal_speed
description: The horizontal distance the entity moved since the last tick, in blocks. Vertical movement is ignored.

name: palladium.is_wall_climbing
description: Whether the player is climbing a wall with Palladium's wall climbing ability.

name: palladium.model_property
description: A value of a model part. Only works inside the overrides of a render layer, returns 0 everywhere else.

arguments.description: Name of the model part, like "head" or "right_arm".
One of x, y, z, x_rot, y_rot, z_rot (radians), x_rot_degrees, y_rot_degrees, z_rot_degrees, x_scale, y_scale, z_scale.

name: palladium.pos_x
description: The entity's X position in the world, smoothed between ticks.

name: palladium.pos_y
description: The entity's Y position in the world, smoothed between ticks.

name: palladium.pos_z
description: The entity's Z position in the world, smoothed between ticks.

name: palladium.swinging_is_hanging
description: Whether the player hangs still on a web line.

name: palladium.swinging_left_arm_pitch
description: A physics based pitch for the left arm while swinging, in degrees. Points up at the anchor when the arm holds the line.

name: palladium.swinging_limb_vel
description: How fast the swinging limbs are currently moving. Useful for secondary motion like legs trailing behind.

name: palladium.swinging_on_left_arm
description: Whether the current web line is attached to the left arm.

name: palladium.swinging_on_right_arm
description: Whether the current web line is attached to the right arm.

name: palladium.swinging_right_arm_pitch
description: A physics based pitch for the right arm while swinging, in degrees. Points up at the anchor when the arm holds the line.

name: palladium.tick_count
description: The entity's age in ticks, including the progress to the next tick for smooth motion.
